A detail the implementer's record omits and a reader should know: killing the local step command does not stop the runner job in the cluster, which ran to completion (steps/killed/step-killed.log ends at 18:03:29 with its own summary). That is the intended behaviour of the fix - the watcher stops no job - but it means a killed step leaves a job running in the copy until it finishes on its own.
